notes: Wrapped from existing Prismata repository artifact.
Preserves source metadata for future unwrap support.

content.text:
header:
  udi: prismata.header.demo.main
  text: Header/Footer Demo
  style: header
  colourScheme: header
  borderScheme: main-menu
  visibilityMode: Static
  visibilityCondition: null
  visibilityDependencies:
    - demo_mode

subheader:
  udi: prismata.header.demo.sub
  text: Section A
  style: subheader
  colourScheme: subheader
  borderScheme: main-menu
  visibilityMode: Conditional
  visibilityCondition: feature_flag('section_a') == true
  visibilityDependencies:
    - section_a

footer:
  udi: prismata.footer.demo.main
  text: F1: Help | F2: Options | Q: Quit
  style: footer
  colourScheme: footer
  borderScheme: main-menu
  visibilityMode: Static
  visibilityCondition: null
  visibilityDependencies:
    - help_enabled

subfooter:
  udi: prismata.subfooter.demo.main
  text: Progress: 73%
  style: subfooter
  colourScheme: footer-progress
  borderScheme: main-menu
  visibilityMode: Conditional
  visibilityCondition: env('SHOW_PROGRESS') == true
  visibilityDependencies:
    - show_progress
